description: Test suite for sender label resolution functions `resolveSenderLabel` and `listSenderLabelCandidates` in `sender-label.js`. The tests verify label formatting preferences and candidate list generation based on sender attributes.

methods.name: resolveSenderLabel
methods.description: Resolves the display label for a sender based on available attributes, preferring display name and e164 number.

methods.name: listSenderLabelCandidates
methods.description: Returns a list of unique, normalized sender label candidates based on sender attributes, including a formatted label.
